in_OrchestratorQueueName.description: Allows the Orchestrator queue name to be passed as an argument, instead of only being defined in the configuration file.

in_OrchestratorQueueFolder.description: Allows the Orchestrator folder name where the queue is created to be passed as an argument, instead of only being defined in the configuration file.

in_WishlistQueueName.description: Lyrebird: output queue for validated albums. Empty = Config WishlistQueueName (Lyrebird_Wishlist). With an _IT input queue this must be an _IT queue.

in_LoadWishlist.description: Lyrebird: load new wishlist rows into the input queue once at job start. Default True.

in_LoadFilter.description: Lyrebird: optional extra filter for the startup load, e.g. id=in.(40,41). Only id, artist, album, preferred_format, submission conditions.

in_MaxTransactions.description: Lyrebird: stop after this many transactions (0 = no limit). Stops between transactions like an Orchestrator stop request.

in_TestFailAfterStep.description: Lyrebird TEST ONLY: performer failure injection (after_reservation | after_enqueue). Refused unless both queues end with _IT.
